_comment: A written decision to keep serving the launch film while its artwork is stale.
The claim in valence-launch-poster.json says what the poster DISPLAYS. This file
says that somebody chose to serve it anyway, which is a different statement and
so lives in a different file: editing the figures must not be able to reach the
passing branch of scripts/check_launch_artwork.py, and a decision must not be one
The gate prints the full drift on every run whether or not this holds, so accepted
stale figures are never quiet. On the day after `review_by` this stops applying and
the gate fails again: an acceptance that could not expire would be a permanent hole
in the check rather than a decision with an end.
TO CLEAR: re-cut the film at the same 16:9 dimensions (the slot does not change),
update valence-launch-poster.json to the figures the model serves, and delete this
file. The gate then passes on the first branch, with nothing to accept.
reason: The hero reserves six columns for a visual and the film is the only one. The poster card will be re-cut at the same 16:9 dimensions, which changes neither the component nor the layout, so the slot stays as it is until the new cut lands rather than shipping an empty column beside the headline.
